Summary.en: Fills several fields of a container from a selected LDAP directory match.
Summary.de: Füllt mehrere Felder eines Containers aus einem ausgewählten LDAP-Verzeichnistreffer.
Summary.it: Compila più campi di un contenitore da un risultato selezionato della directory LDAP.

Parameter.Property: The LDAP-Property used by the autocompleting inputs within the tagged container to look-up the match.
Parameter.CSSProposals: The CSS-Style for the proposals-Select-Element appearing when there are multiple matches.
Parameter.URL: The URL of the Formcycle predefined LDAP-Query to use.

Property.default: The LDAP-Property used by the autocompleting inputs within the tagged container to look-up the match.

CSSProposals.default: The CSS-Style for the proposals-Select-Element appearing when there are multiple matches.

URL.default: The URL of the Formcycle predefined LDAP-Query to use.
